scientific_integrity: The all-sizes theorem has a direct path-component bijection and labelled-cycle argument. Finite enumeration supports but does not prove the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only one partial bijection; not an extension theorem for multiple partial permutations or tournament EPPA. Standard odd-cycle enumeration and exponential formula are prior; equivalent colored-cycle formulas may exist. Exhaustive checks cover at most five original vertices.
title: Sharp one-point odd-order completion and parity-profile census of partial permutations
